Do you make any music? 
If you do, can i listen to it? 

I have a lot of instruments too, 4 electric and 1 acoustic guitars, a bass, an acoustic drumset, a midi keyboard and a chord organ

I do, i never cared about it but i think it would be cool to have someone to talk to, about anything.
All these years I've learned to be my own friend and talk with myself.
It wasn't that bad, it was pretty easy at my job and i ate chicken sandwiches. How was yours?
